stages.summary: The simulator pairs from the exact QR bootstrap, admits the device grant, and projects the desktop thread list on the zero-based home without a selection intent.
The simulator reopens with the persisted resume cursor, rejects an unreachable cached tailnet endpoint, dials the signed announcement endpoint next, and catches up from the returned snapshot.
The simulator observes host shutdown, renders relay and exact staleness evidence, then reconnects to a new engine snapshot and returns honestly to direct.

residual.summary: The mobile client clears a revoked grant and refuses reuse in the simulator. Proof that both the direct host and relay lane enforce one live revocation state requires the still-unimplemented Omega host.
Omega origin/main at the recorded commit has no device bridge server, discovery V3 or QR issuer, or mirror projection feed. No live end-to-end host claim is made.
No owner phone was admitted for this run. Simulator evidence is not presented as physical-device or packaged evidence.
